integrity: The all-length proof uses cyclic run coordinates and sharp singleton-run adjacency bounds. Direct finite enumeration is supporting evidence, not an unrestricted proof. Historical priority has not been independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact noiseless circular binary reads of lengths 1, 2, 3, 4 only; the formula is finite rather than a minimal rational generating function, and no claim about larger alphabets, noisy channels, or arbitrary read lengths is made.
title: Exact codebook count for cyclic binary composition reads of lengths at most four
